brief: Holds JavaScript source as a code graph, parsed by the tree-sitter grammar in the engine with no Node runtime.
detail: A sibling of stzPyCodeGraph under stzCodeGraph: it inherits the whole query surface (classes, methods, owners, ancestry, call edges, dead code, cyclic calls) and declares only its own identity. Build one from a source string with StzJsCodeGraphFromSourceTS or from a directory of .js files with StzJsCodeGraphTS.
receiver: o1 = StzJsCodeGraphFromSourceTS("class Worker { run() { this.step(); } step() {} }")
